claim.statement: M.56's 'concept-set-driven stratum' is empirically LOCALIZED: word ORDER is nearly irrelevant to substrate reasoning. Word-shuffled prompts (same tokens, randomized order) produce nearly-identical reasoning to original prompts: 86.7% halt-mode agreement, walk Jaccard mean 0.892 (median 1.000 — half the prompts produce IDENTICAL walks), and Φ delta exactly 0.0000 across all 15 prompts. The substrate's reasoning input-sensitivity hierarchy is now: PRIMARY concept SET → SECONDARY encoder geometry → TERTIARY word order.
claim.operationalization: 15 prompts × 2 fresh Takwin instances. A: original prompt. B: same tokens with deterministic random shuffle of word order. Per-prompt: halt mode, walk (concept set + order), Φ, n_zetetic. Compare to M.56 baseline (encoder scramble on same prompts).
claim.h0: Word order is one of multiple drivers (Jaccard ~0.5-0.7, similar to encoder scramble)
claim.h1: Word order is barely a driver (Jaccard > 0.85; concept SET dominates)

preregistration.analysis_plan: Word-order shuffle A/B comparison; compare halt agreement + walk Jaccard + Φ delta + zetetic delta vs M.56 encoder-scramble baseline.

detail.interpretation: word-shuffle 89% overlap vs encoder-scramble 73% overlap — word order matters LESS than encoder geometry
Φ is exactly invariant to word order — mechanical determination, not noise tolerance
87% halt agreement vs 80% under encoder scramble
10× less zetetic divergence than under encoder scramble — confirms zetetic is encoder-driven, not order-driven

hierarchy.PRIMARY: concept SET (token identity) — drives Walker + Φ
hierarchy.SECONDARY: encoder geometry — drives zetetic detection + ~25% of walks (M.56)
hierarchy.TERTIARY: word ORDER — barely affects reasoning (~11% walk variance, 0 Φ variance)

verdict.reasoning: Observed walk Jaccard mean 0.892 (median 1.000). The Φ values are EXACTLY INVARIANT (delta 0.0 across all 15 prompts) — this isn't noise tolerance, it's mechanical determination: Φ depends on the concept SET, not on the walk's trajectory specifics. This LOCALIZES M.56's 'concept-set-driven stratum' to the actual concept identities extracted from prompts (likely via tokenization + the M.46 F1' step-0 rule which selects on string-length not order).
